description: This file defines an abstract class CatalogEntity that extends ShopEntity, representing catalog-related data for entities in the application. It includes properties such as name, description, URL, keywords, highlights, meta description, and title, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: CatalogEntity
classes.description: An abstract class representing catalog entities with various descriptive properties, used as a base class for specific catalog-related entities.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the catalog entity.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the catalog entity.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the catalog entity.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the catalog entity.

methods.name: getFriendlyUrl
methods.description: Returns the friendly URL of the catalog entity.

methods.name: setFriendlyUrl
methods.description: Sets the friendly URL of the catalog entity.

methods.name: getKeyWords
methods.description: Returns the keywords associated with the catalog entity.

methods.name: setKeyWords
methods.description: Sets the keywords associated with the catalog entity.

methods.name: getHighlights
methods.description: Returns the highlights of the catalog entity.

methods.name: setHighlights
methods.description: Sets the highlights of the catalog entity.

methods.name: getMetaDescription
methods.description: Returns the meta description of the catalog entity.

methods.name: setMetaDescription

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the catalog entity.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the catalog entity.
